# 2 Baruch Chapter 45 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Third Fast and Vision

---

**45:1** Meditate therefore on these things in your hearts and fix your minds upon the law — and wisdom will instruct you for your good.

**45:2** And I, Baruch, say this to you — you who are here: keep in your hearts all that I have commanded you, so that you may not forget it.

**45:3** For I know that the earth will surely change in that time, and that the heavens will not remain as they are; and that the times will pass away; and that the Most High will renew his whole creation.

**45:4** And those who have been purified by wisdom will be transformed; and the appearance of their face will be turned into the light of beauty; and they will be made like the stars.

**45:5** For what is written in the law will be fulfilled; and all who have not believed will not be able to resist it.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus rendering. Key decisions: "Meditate" (v.1) over EMET's "Think-therefore" — LOGOS's "meditate" captures the reflective quality of the Syriac more richly; "purified by wisdom" (v.4) — all three agree; "the light of beauty" (v.4) retained over PNEUMA's "blazing light of beauty" — "blazing" is added; "made like the stars" (v.4) retained as one of 2 Baruch's most evocative images, echoing Dan 12:3.*
